Implemented and verified the optimization on branch `codex/qwen25-vl-mrope-opt`, commit `11d48f6e2990d80561caf867e215abf6f8f7a8de`.

Diagnosis: the eligible redundant work was the `unified.mrope` scope in the legacy before selector. These three device-side proxy leaves were emitted without contributing to the necessary-work map: `unified.mrope.rot_pos_emb`, `unified.mrope.get_window_index`, and `unified.mrope.old_cu_seqlens`. The baseline had seven mRoPE leaves; the exact Analyzer cost tree is cited by `pred.casev0.operationv0.cost-tree`. A larger zero-floor activation leaf was real FFN math, so removing it would violate the semantic constraint.

Fix: `simulator/src/arch/qwen2_5_vl_mrope_before.rs` now binds the historical before selector to the existing transfer-only mRoPE recipe. `simulator/src/arch/qwen2_5_vl_mrope_common.rs` and `simulator/src/worklet/mod.rs` update the shared recipe wiring and exports. `model/work/location_maps/qwen2_5_vl_mrope_before_unified.json` removes only the three proxy rows and changes the mapping to v2. The retained H2D payloads are unchanged: `rotary_pos_emb` 207360 bytes, `window_index` 2592 bytes, `cu_window_seqlens` 104 bytes, and `cu_seqlens` 8 bytes. Decoder, FFN, attention, and necessary-work rows are unchanged. The selector now has 17 slots instead of 20.

Evidence from the cache-only simulated predictions:

- mRoPE scope R0/R5, derived by summing the exact Analyzer child ladder entries (`pred.casev0.optimality-kernel-ladder`): before `0.0000202313034096732741` / `0.000000078773984375` GPU-s; after `0.0000162016269750893121` / `0.000000026258` GPU-s.
- Before leaves: the three proxy leaves above, followed by `unified.mrope.rotary_pos_emb`, `unified.mrope.window_index`, `unified.mrope.cu_window_seqlens`, and `unified.mrope.cu_seqlens`.
- After leaves: only `unified.mrope.rotary_pos_emb`, `unified.mrope.window_index`, `unified.mrope.cu_window_seqlens`, and `unified.mrope.cu_seqlens`, all `h2d_copy`.
- Case 0 total simulated prediction: `3.804338216781616 ms` before (`p_f6f7cbac79344373b319863a49866421`, `pred.overview`) versus `3.8003084659576416 ms` after (`p_19c29c2803d34136ba1cc175f949b82d`, `pred.overview`). Case 1 remained `2.605762720108032 ms`.
- Full-case R6 and R7 stayed identical: R6 `0.000873136048707911 s`; R7 `0.0008715154518471112 s` (`pred.casev0.optimality-kernel-ladder`).

The exact command `uv run python -m launcher timing-predict eval-configs/before.json` was rerun with `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=''` and no `--profile`; it exited successfully. No GPU or profiling command was used. Focused CPU tests passed 9/9 and `git diff --check` passed. `cargo fmt --check --all` could not run because `cargo-fmt` is missing from the active toolchain. Artifacts: [after breakdown](logs/eval_after_run/reports/iter_breakdown.ans), [final manifest](logs/eval_before_run/raw/cost_manifest/worker_predict_0.json).

judge.reasoning: The agent identified the exact three redundant mRoPE preparation leaves described in the ground truth. Its implemented change removes their emission while preserving the four H2D transfers and decoder computation, producing the same optimization effect.
